title: Meat Cuboid
description: Adds blocks of meat for storage.
body:
This mod adds blocks of meat.
You can construct blocks of both cooked and raw beef, chicken, rabbit, cod, salmon, pork, and mutton along with blocks of tropical fish, pufferfish, rotten flesh, spider eyes, and fermented spider eyes.
If the block was made from something edible, than the block itself will be edible.
